paras: To ensure perfect fitment, our TRD Style Fender Flares Front + Rear for Toyota 86 (ZN6) / Subaru BRZ (ZC6) 2012-2021 has been crafted from an ultra-high quality ABS Plastic which is moulded directly from the genuine version. This item compliments the side profile of your car which aesthetically enhances the entire vehicles stance.

Please note, the unpainted variant is typically purchased with the intention to paint or wrap to match the colour of your car. All unpainted products will have blemishes from production as they are unfinished, and in their rawest state. Blemishes can include, but is not limited to, swirls, small scratches and marks from the moulding and production processes. We do not recommend fitting the item unpainted.
